quote: We introduce DreamSync, a simple yet effective framework that improves T2I generation faithfulness while maintaining aesthetic appeal.
We use VQA models to evaluate the faithfulness of the generation model... We measure the faithfulness of a caption-image pair (T, I) given all questions and answers, using two metrics.

We use BLIP-2 as the VQA model to measure the faithfulness of the generation model... we use VILA to measure the aesthetics measurement score... We also use ImageReward, an off-the-shelf human preference model, to evaluate generated images.

We use a collection of three evaluation methods to evaluate DreamSync: VQA evaluation for generated images on both TIFA and DSG benchmarks, human evaluation, and ImageReward for automatic human preference prediction.

We conduct a large-scale human study to understand the capability of DreamSync, where we use the full set of 1,060 images in DSG. During the study, we ask approximately 8 fine-grained questions for each of 1060 images to external raters.
We conduct a human study with over 1000 images ... each image is rated by 3 human raters. ... we ask approximately 8 fine-grained questions for each of 1060 images to external raters.

Raters answer fine-grained yes/no questions about each image, covering categories such as entity, attribute, relation, and global aspects.

The inner-annotator agreement for this study is 0.684.
